description.en: Attaches an avatar (keshin/mascot) to a character.
Character handle to attach the avatar to.
ID of the avatar to attach.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Attach an avatar to a character
CMND_ATTACH_AVATAR(_chr, _avt);
